claims: Sarah is the wife of Abraham.
Sarah is the mother of Isaac.
Hagar is Sarah’s handmaiden.
Hagar was supported by God in the desert.
Hagar is the mother of Abraham's son Ishmael.
Rebekah is the wife of Isaac.
Leah and Rachel are wives of Jacob.
Leah and Rachel are central matriarchs of the twelve tribes of Israel.
Esther is an orphaned Jewish queen.
Esther used her position to save her people from destruction.
Deborah is a prophetess.
Deborah is the only female judge.
Deborah led Israel.
Ruth is a Moabite woman.
Ruth has a role in the genealogy of David.
Miriam is a prophetess.
Miriam is the sister of Moses.
Miriam helped lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
Mary is the mother of Jesus.
Mary Magdalene is a devoted follower of Jesus.
Mary Magdalene is the first to witness and testify to the Resurrection.
Elizabeth is the mother of John the Baptist.
Anna is a prophetess.
Anna recognized the infant Jesus as the Messiah in the temple.
Lydia is a seller of purple cloth.
Lydia became a prominent supporter of Paul's ministry.
Priscilla is a leader in the early church.
Priscilla taught and worked alongside Paul
"The Faithful: Women of the Bible (2026)" is a TV drama.
"The Faithful: Women of the Bible (2026)" highlights the stories of Genesis matriarchs.
"Twelve Extraordinary Women" is a study focusing on the lives of figures like Hannah, Rahab, and Martha.
"Women of the Bible Devotionals" are books that often highlight 52 women.
